text:
rachel_billing: Ping — BrightArc disputed March invoice INV-BA-03: they saw ~9% over-commit after a DR failover to APAC on 2026-03-05. asking for breakdown + adjustment.

marco_finance: please paste the invoice id & any raw meter lines. need to check whether tokens were charged to burst or reserved.

rachel_billing: INV-BA-03 attached. customer excerpt: 'we failed over to ap-southeast for ~1.5h; billing shows a spike we didn't expect'.

josh_ops: quick read: BrightArc's reserved pool is eu-north only. we don't mirror reserved capacity cross-region by default. fallback is shared burst. however, there was a short routing blip at 03:22 UTC that sent traffic to ap-southeast. pasted sanitized meters below:
```
meter: customer=brightarc region=ap-southeast bucket=burst tokens=290000 ts=2026-03-05T03:25:11Z
meter: customer=brightarc region=eu-north bucket=reserved tokens=1_030_000 ts=2026-03-05T02:40:00Z
meter: customer=brightarc region=ap-southeast bucket=burst tokens=180000 ts=2026-03-05T03:40:02Z
```

josh_ops: total APAC burst ~470k tokens.

emma_prod: do we have any recent product notes where sales promised cross-region reserved for DR? should check contract addendum.

nina_sales: sales notes say they asked for "DR-ready failover" during demo; no explicit contract clause. we likely need to handle as expectation mismatch.

marco_finance: unit burst rate for their plan = $0.0048/token (enterprise). provisional credit calc: 470000 * 0.0048 = $2,256. recommend provisional goodwill credit while ops investigates.

oliver_cfo: provisional up to $2.5k is fine. require RCA and final memo before closing. log the decision.

josh_ops: opened OPS-6320 to audit routing and add billing-exception tags for DR windows. ETA 72h.

emma_prod: product action: add customer-visible doc explaining reserved scope vs cross-region failover. PROD-5207.

metering-bot: export available s3://redwood-metering/exports/brightarc/2026-03-05/1837777777-export.csv

rachel_billing: I will send customer a provisional note: "We've applied a provisional credit of $2,256 while we complete an RCA (48-72h). Final outcome subject to RCA." ok?

nina_sales: good. add invite to a short tech sync to reassure them.

marco_finance: approve processing credit $2,256. please include token math and unit rates in memo and tag for legal review if customer requests contract amendment.

oliver_cfo: confirmed. keep thread open until OPS-6320 closes.

rachel_billing: credit issued and memo sent. flagged invoice INV-BA-03 as under review. will update when RCA done. :white_check_mark:
